description: Questions about this repository whose answer spans several files. Coverage is the share of expected files named in the answer.

tasks.prompt: Trace a tool call end to end: from the model's streamed tool call in the agent loop, through permission checks and approval, to execution on the user's device and the result returning to the model.
Explain how context compaction works end to end: when it is triggered, which model writes the summary, how the summary is stored and how the next model request is assembled from it.
Explain how session events reach the desktop UI in order and how a client catches up after a reconnect, on both the backend and the desktop side.
Explain how rewinding a session to an earlier turn works, including how files changed by the agent are restored, on the backend, in the executor and in the desktop UI.
Explain how a session worktree is created, how tool calls are redirected into it, and how it is merged or discarded, on the backend and in the executor.
Explain how requests to a local model server are relayed from the backend through the desktop app, and which hosts the desktop refuses to call.
